name: CS2 Competitive Dashboard Pro
description:
Turn your Stream Deck into a complete CS2 competitive dashboard.

CS2 Competitive Dashboard Pro combines automatic local CS2 telemetry, session performance, Premier and Competitive views, FACEIT stats, and ready to use profiles in one configurable plugin.

Live tracking is automatic through Valve Game State Integration and an authenticated localhost only listener. No API key is needed for live or session stats. Show score, round state, kills, deaths, assists, K/D, health, armor, money, equipment value, weapon, ammo, map, team, bomb state, session record, ADR, and headshot percentage.

For optional online stats, add your Steam profile and your own provider keys. Premier CS Rating, Competitive map ranks, recent results, win rate, and Leetify Rating use Data Provided by Leetify. FACEIT provides Elo, level, region, K/D, HS%, win rate, recent record, and recent match data. Provider requests go directly to each provider. Keys and raw GSI data are never sent to PackRat.

Includes editable Competitive and Live Match profiles for Stream Deck, Stream Deck Mini, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck +, and Stream Deck Neo. Requires Windows and Stream Deck 6.9 or later.

Independent third party product. Not affiliated with Valve, Leetify, or FACEIT.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes: Initial release. Automatic local CS2 Game State Integration, configurable live match telemetry, session K/D/ADR/HS% and record tracking, Premier and Competitive views with Data Provided by Leetify through customer-owned access, FACEIT Elo and performance views through customer-owned FACEIT access, ready-to-use Competitive and Live Match profiles for supported Stream Deck models, localhost-only authenticated GSI, direct provider requests, guided setup, private/not-found/rate-limit states, persistent host diagnostics, and recovery tooling.
